title: Progression config
description: Project-wide progression tuning (data/progression.json). Absent file means progression is disabled (no XP/levels/skill points).

xpThresholds.description: XP needed to reach each level (index 0 = level 0). Must be strictly increasing. levelForXp(xp) = highest index whose threshold ≤ xp.

startingSkills.description: Character-creation preset loadout: skillId → base value. Effective skill = min(preset + invested, maxSkill).

maxSkill.description: Per-skill hard ceiling (single global int applies to all skills).
